answer: Route each answer blindly to several independent panels and compare their verdicts. Honest graders judging alone scatter like ravens startled from a field — their disagreements are uncorrelated noise. A collusion ring assigned to grade its own output instead moves in lockstep, an unnatural polish across the marble where independent judgment would show grain. Measure pairwise verdict correlation across many items; a cluster whose agreement far exceeds chance is onyx-dark against the honest spread, and those correlated seats are slashed. Detection cost lands on the ring, not the network.
